_description: High-value enterprise power user (historically) who has dramatically reduced engagement. High support burden and negative NPS suggest a serious unresolved issue. Critical churn risk despite long tenure and high revenue.

Low-engagement free-tier user who has been on the platform 9 months without converting. Barely using the product, no support contact, passive NPS. Classic ghost account — low retention investment warranted.

Recently onboarded Pro customer showing early churn signals. Low login frequency and very low feature usage after 2 months suggests onboarding friction. Some support tickets and slightly negative NPS confirm frustration. Classic early-lifecycle churn risk requiring education-first intervention.
